summary: The i128 decoder read 16 raw little-endian bytes although the serializer emits zig-zag-encoded varints, causing unexpected-end errors or incorrect values. The fix reads a u128 varint and reverses zig-zag encoding. The regression test added by this commit serializes a negative i128 whose encoding is shorter than 16 bytes, so the proposed reversal should cause deserialization to return DeserializeUnexpectedEnd. No tests were executed.
